title: Model Mixup
text:
Model Mixup. Just spoke with Dirt Devil and the red model that sounds like it's crap is Model #08245, not the Platnium Force Model #08240 which Amazon is currently selling (and I am buying). The woman stated the that Platinum Force does have 2 motors and she also agreed that that Power Reach (red one) will actually stop if you push too hard on it. So some of these reviews sound like they are referring to the Power Reach, not the Platinum Force.
If Amazon is showing this model and shipping out the Power Reach I would think that they would pay to ship the wrong item back. (THEY BETTER)! I will write a review once I receive mine and use it.

product_metadata.title: Dirt Devil 08240 Platinum Force Hand Vac
features: Powerful, 720-watt, bagless, handheld vacuum doubles as mini-canister
Nozzle detaches for cleaning stairs, upholstery, auto interiors
Two-motor system, one for suction, one in nozzle for brush-roll
Stretch hose for nozzle, with onboard crevice tool
Permanent drive belt never needs replacing; 20-foot power cord
description: Probably the most powerful handheld available, this 720-watt vacuum doubles as a mini-canister, because its nozzle detaches for cleaning stairs, upholstery, auto interiors, and hard-to-reach places. Two motors ensure efficient performance. One is for suction, the other powers the nozzle's brush roll so embedded dirt can be captured. The bagless vacuum has a transparent plastic dirt container that releases with the push of a button. The nozzle's hose can be stretched, providing several feet of reach, and a 20-foot power cord permits going up stairs and into automobiles. Stored in a slot atop the vacuum is a crevice tool that attaches to the hose. Unlike most vacuums with a powered brush roll, this one never needs to have its drive belt replaced: the belt is permanent. The vacuum measures 16-1/2 inches long, 9 inches high (to top of hose), and 5-1/2 inches wide. It carries a two-year warranty against defects.
